changeSet.sql: with uuids as (select unnest(array['${subcatalog.uuid}', '${child1.uuid}', '${child2.uuid}']) uuid) insert into metadatastatus (changedate, changemessage, metadataid, owner, userid, uuid, statusid) (select to_char(metadata.changedate::timestamptz+interval '1 minute', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'), 'Enable workflow', metadata.id, 0, 1, uuid, 1 from uuids inner join metadata using (uuid));

with uuids as (select unnest(array['${subcatalog.uuid}', '${child1.uuid}', '${child2.uuid}']) uuid) insert into metadatastatus (changedate, changemessage, metadataid, owner, userid, uuid, statusid) (select to_char(metadata.changedate::timestamptz+interval '2 minute', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'), '', metadata.id, 0, 1, uuid, 2 from uuids inner join metadata using (uuid));
